## Questions & answers.
Something else on your mind? [Get in touch](mailto:team@screen.studio?subject=Screen%20Studio).

How is Screen Studio different from other screen recording apps?

Screen Studio records your screen differently than most apps.

It records your screen, ignoring the mouse cursor, and then adds the cursor back in the final video. This is possible because Screen Studio records precise mouse movement data and synchronizes it with the recorded video.

Thanks to this, it can apply many effects after the video is recorded, such as making mouse movement smooth, changing cursor size and shape, etc.

Most screen recording apps record your screen with the mouse cursor, making it impossible to apply cursor effects after the recording is done.

Is the Windows version ready?

No, and there are no near-future plans to add Windows support. Currently, Screen Studio only supports macOS.

Is Screen Studio privacy-focused?

Yes.

Screen Studio never sends data about your recordings to servers.

Your recordings are stored and processed locally on your computer.

AI-based features, such as transcription, are done locally on your computer.

Screen Studio can collect basic usage data to help us improve the app, but you can opt out of it during the first launch. You can also opt out at any time in the app settings.

Is there an education discount?

Yes.

If you have an email address from a university or other educational institution, you can automatically get a 40% discount on Screen Studio at [Request Educational Discount](/license/request-educational-discount) page.

If you don't have an educational email address, you can send us confirmation of your student status (such as a student ID) at [team@screen.studio](mailto:team@screen.studio) and we will send you a discount code.

What features will be added in the future?

Please check out the [roadmap](/roadmap) page.

What macOS version is required?

macOS Ventura 13.1 or higher is recommended.

Please check out the [manage subscription](https://app.lemonsqueezy.com/my-orders) page.

What happens if I purchased a one-time license in the past?

Your license is of course still valid.

If your access to the latest updates and features is expired, you can still renew your license at any time to restore your access to the latest updates and features.

Note: purchasing one-time licenses was possible in the past, but is no longer available for new purchases.

title: Scrubber | Screen Studio
content:
Editing project

# Scrubber
Scrubber is an editing tool that allows you to manually navigate through a video, enabling you to listen to your voice and pinpoint exact editing points.

## **How to use a scrubber**
1. Begin by opening your project in Screen Studio
2. Find the **`scrubber`** positioned above the timeline
3. Click on the scrubber to activate it
4. Move the playhead to the right to play the media forward. Drag it to the left to play it backward. This allows for precise navigation through your content.

The speed of the audio or video playback will correspond to how quickly you drag the mouse. The faster you drag, the quicker the playback.Once you've found the exact spot you need, you can perform your edits, such as deleting unwanted sections or making other adjustments.

title: Captions | Screen Studio
content:
Look & Feel

# Captions
Screen Studio allows you to generate multilingual captions for your videos using the Whisper AI model, which processes the captions locally on your device. Alternatively, you can utilize Apple Speech Recognition, which also generates transcripts locally through Apple's native speech recognition engine, requiring macOS 26.0 or later. All captions are created based on your voiceover.

## Creating captions
By default, captions are turned off. If you want to create captions for your recording, open the `Captions` settings.

💡 Please note that if you didn't record your microphone audio, this option won't be available.

You will have a few options to select:

**`AI model to use`** - Choose from three models: `Base`, `Small`, and `Medium`. Base prioritizes speed, Small balances accuracy and speed, and Medium provides the highest accuracy at the cost of processing time and storage.

**`Language`** - Language should be detected automatically; however, you can choose the specific one to avoid some potential mistakes.

**`Prompt`** - This is optional, but prompts will help generate an accurate transcript for your recording. It's useful, especially when you are using custom names, such as your product name.

Once everything is ready click on `Generate transcript` button. This might take a few minutes, especially if you are generating transcripts for longer videos or using a larger AI model.

## Editing captions
Once the transcript is generated, you will see captions on your video preview, and other options for editing captions will be available.

You can hide the transcript and adjust caption size in your video.

To fix errors in the transcript, click `Edit transcript` to open the editor and correct any typos.

You can also export the transcript as a separate file.

title: Cursor | Screen Studio
content:
Look & Feel

# Cursor
In Screen Studio, you have a variety of options to customize how the cursor appears and behaves in your recording.

## Cursor Settings
**`Hide cursor`** - Completely removes the cursor from your recording, ideal for presentations or tutorials where the cursor may be distracting.

**`Cursor size`** - Adjusts the size of the cursor to make it more visible or subtle depending on your needs.

**`Cursor type`** - Choose between macOS or Touch cursor styles to match your operating system or personal preference. The Touch cursor is mostly used for recordings on iPads and iPhones.

**`Always use default system cursor`** - Ensures consistency by always using your system’s default cursor, avoiding changes during different actions like text selection.

**`Hide cursor if it's not moving`** - Automatically hides the cursor when it's idle, keeping your viewers' focus on the main content.

**`Loop cursor position`** - Near the end of the video, cursor will move back to its initial position. You can use this option to create a perfect loop.

## **Advanced Cursor Settings**
Screen Studio provides advanced settings to further refine cursor behavior. Click on `Advanced` in the same menu to toggle the list of additional options.

**`Rotate cursor while moving`** - Adds a dynamic effect by slightly rotating the cursor, mimicking the natural movement of chasing the mouse.

**`Stop cursor movement at the end of the video`** - Controls the cursor to stop moving before the video ends, avoiding unwanted captures like stopping the recording.

**`Remove cursor shakes`** - Useful for eliminating unintended cursor movements, often caused by accessibility tools.

**`Optimize original cursor types`** - Minimize rapid changes in cursor types during recording to ensure smoother transitions for a better viewer experience.

title: Camera | Screen Studio
content:
Look & Feel

# Camera
If you used a camera during the recording, then you can modify its position and shape visible in the final recording.

[](https://cdn.sanity.io/files/2ltoq22u/production/b9b717f345ea10f81d8e28168cfd89ee10081b60.mp4)

## Camera settings
**`Hide camera`** - If you prefer not to use your camera, you can hide it during recording.

**`Position`** - You can select the position of your camera in your recording.

**`Mirror camera`** - Use it to mirror your camera view.

**`Roudness`** - Allows you to change the roundness of your camera frame.

**`Size`** - Enables you to change the size of your camera frame.

## Camera during zoom
There is an additional option to manage the camera size during zoom.

Usually, when there is a zoom in the recording, we decrease the size of your camera frame to avoid covering the content of your recording.

You can change the size of the camera during zooms, or you can turn it off to keep the size of your camera frame always the same.

[](https://cdn.sanity.io/files/2ltoq22u/production/8dcb42992392454afedefa8c9f1fccb3a2255f44.mp4)

Privacy

## Offline first.
Screen Studio works offline without feeling limited. **Cloud features are optional,** many have an on-device alternative, and they’re there for what your Mac can’t do on its own. You’re always told before anything leaves your Mac.

### On your Mac
- **Recordings and projects.** Saved on your Mac, wherever you keep them.
- **Transcripts and captions.** Transcribed locally, with Whisper or Apple’s speech recognition.
- **Voice enhancement.** Noise reduction and Podcast mode run on-device.
- **Face tracking and cutouts.** Your camera is framed and cut out by your Mac.
- **Enhancements and export.** Debanding, super resolution, and encoding all happen on your Mac.

### Only when you choose
- **Shareable links.** Uploaded when you create one. You’re asked before the first upload.
- **Shared projects.** Sent when you share a project with someone.
- **Cloud transcription.** Optional. The audio is deleted from the server once the transcript is back.
- **AI voiceover.** The text you type is sent to generate the voice.

Whenever something is about to leave your Mac, Screen Studio tells you right where you choose it.

Usage analytics never include the content of your recordings, and you can turn them off in Settings anytime.

## Questions & answers.
Something else on your mind? [Get in touch](mailto:team@screen.studio?subject=Screen%20Studio).

How is Screen Studio different from other screen recording apps?

Screen Studio records your screen differently than most apps.

It records your screen, ignoring the mouse cursor, and then adds the cursor back in the final video. This is possible because Screen Studio records precise mouse movement data and synchronizes it with the recorded video.

Thanks to this, it can apply many effects after the video is recorded, such as making mouse movement smooth, changing cursor size and shape, etc.

Most screen recording apps record your screen with the mouse cursor, making it impossible to apply cursor effects after the recording is done.

Is the Windows version ready?

No, and there are no near-future plans to add Windows support. Currently, Screen Studio only supports macOS.

Is Screen Studio privacy-focused?

Yes.

Screen Studio never sends data about your recordings to servers.

Your recordings are stored and processed locally on your computer.

AI-based features, such as transcription, are done locally on your computer.

Screen Studio can collect basic usage data to help us improve the app, but you can opt out of it during the first launch. You can also opt out at any time in the app settings.
